summary: Verified guest maintenance page (Inertia Errors/Maintenance Vue) at /. Initially the page rendered blank due to CORS: Laravel generated asset URLs from the internal cluster host (cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud) because the proxy forwards Host header as the cluster domain, while the browser loaded the doc from preview.emergentagent.com. JS bundle + Keenicons/Bootstrap fonts were blocked by CORS, so Vue never hydrated. Fixed by adding ASSET_URL=<preview.emergentagent.com> to /app/.env so Vite/asset() emits same-origin URLs. After fix, everything works: HTTP 503, data-testid='maintenance-page' visible, all required content (artirdim.com logo, 'CANLI MÜZAYEDE SİSTEMİ' badge, 'Çekici Deneyimler İçin Alanı Güncelliyoruz' title, %75 progress, Durum: Optimizasyon + Hedef: %98 Hazır, footer) renders, dark theme by default, theme toggle switches dark<->light and updates localStorage.theme, moon<->sun icon swaps. 0 pageerror; only console 'error' entry is the expected 503 on the document itself.

integration_issues.issue: Laravel-generated asset/Ziggy URLs used internal cluster host (cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud) causing CORS blocks and blank Vue page when accessed via preview.emergentagent.com. Root cause: reverse proxy forwards Host as cluster host; Laravel uses request Host to build URLs. Mitigated by ASSET_URL env. Ziggy config('app.url') still emits cluster URL – may affect route() calls from frontend later.

action_items: Keep ASSET_URL pinned to the public preview URL, or add URL::forceRootUrl(config('app.url')) in a ServiceProvider so all Ziggy/route() URLs also become same-origin. Otherwise route() from Vue will still hit cluster host and be blocked by CORS for future authenticated routes.
Optional: add TrustProxies with X-Forwarded-Host support or configure proxy to forward the external host.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckMaintenanceMode middleware sets 503 correctly and only for guests on '/'. Good.
Errors/Maintenance.vue uses scoped mnt- prefixed classes; no conflicts. Standalone layout works.
app.blade.php theme bootstrap script correctly reads localStorage before hydration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: maintenance_mode is currently ON. Guest visit to / returns 503 with rendered Vue Maintenance page. Admin/admin paths are exempt. If ASSET_URL is later removed or overridden, CORS blank-page issue will return.
rca of the issue: Reverse proxy fronting the Laravel app forwards Host: cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud, so config('app.url')-derived and asset() URLs targeted that origin. Browser loaded HTML from preview.emergentagent.com and JS/font requests to the cluster host lacked Access-Control-Allow-Origin -> blocked -> blank page (only the raw HTML shell of Inertia was there). Fix: ASSET_URL forces asset() to emit preview.emergentagent.com origin, eliminating cross-origin bundle load.
